doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Sculpting and painting as his real profession
summary: Heard has made art since age nine and wants to combine images and textures with music.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Tell us about your sculpting and your painting and your art.
Was this something that was always part of you and you were doing —
Yeah? But you got into the music, and did that for a while, but now you have this —

I have a whole different concept about those two. In my artwork I want to put the music and in the music I want to put the images and stuff, the colors and the textures and stuff. So I’ve got it all kind of turned around. But it works.
And you continue to do that now?
